name: SKS 36" Stainless Steel Natural Gas Rangetop
shortDescription: Two Ultra-High™ burners supply 23K BTUs of exceptional cooking power, enhancing searing capabilities alongside convertible wok grates for swift and safer stir-frying. Two Ultra-Low™ burners easily sustain temperatures as low as 100°, perfect for crafting delicate sauces and sweet confections.

features.text: A stunning chromium griddle in the center ensures uniform heat distribution across its entirety, delivering restaurant-quality outcomes, while its polished finish guarantees resistance to scratches.
The chromium griddle delivers consistent, even heating across the entire surface for professional results and the durable, polished finish resists scratches.

Three Ultra-High Burners deliver 23K BTUs of pure cooking power for better searing and quick stir frying Three Ultra-Low Burners simmer down to maintain temperatures as low as 100° to prepare delicate sauces and sugary confections.
The two front burner grates are convertible for round bottom wok cooking. Stir fry at home with professional style results.

Each burner has a dedicated Smart Knob™ featuring a large, illuminated display that makes it easy to read from across the room. Smart Knobs™ include a Wi-Fi function that let you see if the burner is on or off using the ThinQ® app.
